name: weather
title: Weather
description: Current local weather from Open-Meteo: quiet when ordinary, present for rain, fog, wind and uncomfortable temperatures.
author: pal

settings.label: Location
settings.description: A place name, optionally narrowed by region or country: “Istanbul”, “London, Ontario”, “Paris, Texas”. Only the first part is searched; the rest choose between same-named places. Resolved privately by Open-Meteo's location search.

settings.label: Additional notable weather codes
settings.description: Optional WMO weather codes that should surface even within the temperature band.

settings.label: Bar item
settings.description: When the Weather item is drawn. Always draws the reading in ordinary weather too, muted, so the forecast stays a click away; notable conditions keep their colour.

weather.description: Current temperature, condition, feels-like temperature, humidity and wind for the configured place.

weather.title: Weather
weather.description: A quiet condition-led weather signal: hidden in ordinary weather, visible for rain, fog, wind or temperatures outside your comfort band. The popover is the forecast: the reading now with feels-like, humidity, wind and rain, the next eight hours from this one, then four days of high, low and the chance of rain, with sunrise and sunset.

always.title: Ordinary weather, kept on the bar (Always)

features: A named city or postal code resolved through Open-Meteo—no account, token or Home Assistant
Current condition, temperature, feels-like, humidity and wind
The bar is deliberately hidden in ordinary weather and returns for a condition or temperature worth noticing
Settings previews cover rain, heat, fog, quiet and unavailable states
